mapper.select: SELECT id repository_id,name repository_name,normalized_name,owner_account_id,ownership_version,repository_status FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id account_id,a.username,a.display_name,a.account_role,a.enabled, CASE WHEN a.id=r.owner_account_id THEN 'OWNER' ELSE p.permission_level END relationship, p.permission_level FROM repositories r JOIN accounts a ON a.id=r.owner_account_id LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON FALSE WHERE r.id=#{repositoryId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.id,a.username,a.display_name,a.account_role,a.enabled,p.permission_level,p.permission_level FROM repository_permissions p JOIN accounts a ON a.id=p.account_id JOIN repositories r ON r.id=p.repo_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.repo_id=#{repositoryId} ORDER BY relationship,username
SELECT id,username,display_name,enabled FROM accounts WHERE enabled=TRUE ORDER BY display_name,username,id
SELECT id,username,display_name,enabled FROM accounts WHERE id=#{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_permissions(account_id,repo_id,permission_level,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{accountId},#{repositoryId},#{permission},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(account_id,repo_id) DO UPDATE SET permission_level=EXCLUDED.permission_level,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM repository_permissions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE repositories SET ownership_version=ownership_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{repositoryId} AND ownership_version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE repositories SET owner_account_id=#{newOwnerId},name=#{newName},normalized_name=#{normalizedName}, ownership_version=ownership_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{repositoryId} AND ownership_version=#{expectedVersion} AND repository_status IN ('READY','AUTH_ERROR') AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE repositories SET repository_status='DELETING',deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ownership_version=ownership_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{repositoryId} AND ownership_version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_deletion_tombstones(repository_id,deleted_by,deleted_at) VALUES(#{repositoryId},#{deletedBy},#{deletedAt}) ON CONFLICT(repository_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE repository_deletion_tombstones SET cleanup_status='RUNNING',cleanup_updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE repository_id=( SELECT repository_id FROM repository_deletion_tombstones WHERE cleanup_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') OR (cleanup_status='RUNNING' AND cleanup_updated_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '10 minutes') ORDER BY cleanup_updated_at,deleted_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) RETURNING repository_id
